notes: Use a Troika card for the metro (the stations are among the most beautiful in the world and worth a tour); Yandex Go for taxis. Aeroexpress serves the airports.
Visa: Turkish citizens can stay 60 days visa-free; others need an e-visa. Foreign bank cards do not work (2026), so carry cash roubles or a MIR card; there is no Google Pay.
Winter brings -10°C and snow. Red Square has an ice rink and a Christmas market (December-February); try a banya (Sanduny), and the metro is warm.
Pelmeni 400-600 RUB, Georgian restaurant 1,500-2,500, stolovaya 300; tip 10%.
Book the Kremlin and Armoury online 2 weeks ahead. Lenin's Mausoleum is open Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday mornings; expect a 30-minute queue.
In churches women cover their heads and men remove their hats; photography may be banned inside.

transit.name: Troika Card
transit.why_chosen: Covers metro, bus and tram; the metro stations are among the most beautiful in the world.
transit.coverage: Moskova Metrosu, otobüs, tramvay, Aeroexpress ayrı

stops.name: Red Square
stops.tips: Empty in the morning; see St. Basil's and the GUM facades. Lenin's Mausoleum is open Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday 10:00-13:00.

stops.name: St. Basil's Cathedral
stops.tips: Onion-domed cathedral; narrow stairs and icons inside.

stops.name: Moscow Kremlin & Armoury
stops.tips: Kremlin cathedrals plus the Armoury (Fabergé eggs). Book online 2 weeks ahead; closed Thursday; Armoury entry is timed.

stops.name: GUM Gastronom No.1
stops.tips: GUM's Soviet-themed food hall; ice cream (plombir) and a cafeteria.

stops.name: Zaryadye Park Floating Bridge
stops.tips: Modern park next to the Kremlin; a bridge over the river and an ice cave. Go at sunset.

backups.name: State Historical Museum
backups.tips: The red museum on Red Square; a fallback if you have no Kremlin ticket.

stops.name: Tretyakov Gallery
stops.tips: Russian painting: Repin, Vrubel and icons (Rublev's Trinity). Closed Monday.

stops.name: Zamoskvorechye Streets
stops.tips: Old merchant district; Pyatnitskaya Street and its churches.

stops.name: Lepim i Varim Pyatnitskaya
stops.tips: Handmade pelmeni (dumplings) with a choice of fillings.

stops.name: Muzeon Park & Krymskaya Naberezhnaya
stops.tips: Soviet sculpture park (including the toppled Dzerzhinsky) and the riverside.

stops.name: Gorky Park
stops.tips: Ice rink in winter (skate hire available) and hot tea.

backups.name: Cafe Pushkin
backups.tips: Aristocratic Russian cuisine on Tverskoy; reserve ahead.

backups.name: Garage Museum of Contemporary Art
backups.tips: Contemporary art in Gorky Park, in a building by Rem Koolhaas.

stops.name: Komsomolskaya Metro Station
stops.tips: Baroque station with mosaics; start of the metro tour (use a Troika card).

stops.name: Mayakovskaya Metro Station
stops.tips: Art deco steel arches and ceiling mosaics.

stops.name: Ploshchad Revolyutsii Metro
stops.tips: Bronze statues; rub the dog's nose.

stops.name: Arbat Street
stops.tips: Pedestrian street with matryoshka dolls, street musicians and Pushkin's house.

stops.name: Mari Vanna Moscow
stops.tips: Russian cuisine in a grandmother's-home setting; borscht and pelmeni.

backups.name: Pushkin Museum of Fine Arts
backups.tips: Impressionists and Egypt; an alternative to Arbat.

stops.name: VDNKh
stops.tips: Soviet exhibition of achievements: the Friendship of Peoples fountain and the Kosmos pavilion (paid museum). The grounds are free.

stops.name: Museum of Cosmonautics
stops.tips: Beneath the Monument to the Conquerors of Space; Gagarin and Sputnik.

stops.name: VDNKh Pavilion Cafeteria
stops.tips: Soviet stolovaya (canteen) inside the exhibition grounds; shashlik.

stops.name: Ostankino TV Tower
stops.tips: 540 m tower; bring your passport. Glass floor, timed entry.

backups.name: Botanical Garden VDNKh
backups.tips: Botanical garden beside the exhibition grounds; an alternative to the tower.

stops.name: Trinity Lavra of St. Sergius
stops.tips: 1 hour by train from Yaroslavsky station. The heart of Russian Orthodoxy: blue and gold domes, the shrine of St. Sergius. Bring a headscarf.

stops.name: Lavra Trapeznaya Canteen
stops.tips: Monastery canteen; fish and kvass.

stops.name: Sergiev Posad Toy Museum
stops.tips: The birthplace of the matryoshka; wooden toys.

stops.name: Blinnaya Gora Viewpoint
stops.tips: Postcard view of the monastery from a hilltop.

backups.name: Gostevaya Izba Sergiev Posad
backups.tips: Lunch in a traditional Russian izba (log house).

backups.name: Abramtsevo Estate
backups.tips: Artists' colony estate; a museum alternative on the way.

stops.name: Kolomenskoye
stops.tips: Riverside tsar's estate: the Church of the Ascension (UNESCO), a replica wooden palace and apple orchards.

stops.name: Kolomenskoye Tea House
stops.tips: Samovar tea and blini in the park.

stops.name: Moscow City Federation Tower Panorama 360
stops.tips: Observation deck on the 89th floor; free ice cream, views over the skyscraper district.

stops.name: Khachapuri Restaurant Bolshaya Gruzinskaya
stops.tips: Georgian chain with khachapuri (cheese bread) and khinkali (dumplings), a Moscow favourite.

stops.name: Patriarch's Ponds
stops.tips: Bulgakov's pond; cafes and an evening stroll.

backups.name: Novodevichy Convent
backups.tips: Red-walled convent and a cemetery of famous figures; an alternative to the skyscrapers.

stops.name: Bolshoi Theatre
stops.tips: Facade and square; performance tickets sell out months ahead. Photograph it in the morning.

stops.name: Eliseevsky / Tverskaya
stops.tips: Tverskaya Street: coffee and souvenirs (Christmas atmosphere in winter).

stops.name: Cafe Pushkin Konditerskaya
stops.tips: Pushkin's pastry shop; cake and coffee for a farewell.

stops.name: Aeroexpress Belorussky
stops.tips: Aeroexpress to Sheremetyevo takes 35 minutes; farewell.

backups.name: Dr. Zhivago Restaurant
backups.tips: Stylish Soviet-style breakfast at the National Hotel.

backups.name: Bunker-42
backups.tips: Cold War bunker tour; an alternative to the Bolshoi.
